task.description:
Design the task operation endpoints for API-04.

API-04 requires these endpoints:
1. GET /tasks - list tasks, paginated (API-06), filterable by assignee_id, status, instance_id. TASK_WORKER sees only their own tasks; PROCESS_OPERATOR and above see all.
2. GET /tasks/:id - returns task including status, instance_id, node_id, assignee_type, assignee_ref, created_at. HTTP 404 if not found.
3. POST /tasks/:id/complete - completes task per EE-04. Body: { output_variables: {...} }. HTTP 409 if already completed or cancelled.
4. POST /tasks/:id/assign - assigns an unassigned task to a specific user. Body: { user_id: '...' }. HTTP 409 if task already assigned.
5. POST /tasks/:id/reassign - changes the assignee of an already-assigned task. Requires PROCESS_OPERATOR or above.

Produce a design artifact at src/design/api-04-task-operations.md covering:
- Request/response types (Zig structs) for all five endpoints
- Role-based visibility rules for GET /tasks (TASK_WORKER vs PROCESS_OPERATOR+)
- Pagination parameter handling per API-06 conventions
- Filter parameter handling (assignee_id, status, instance_id query params)
- How to invoke EE-04 task completion from the complete endpoint
- Error response codes for each endpoint
- Edge cases: TASK_WORKER completing another task owner's task (403), task for CANCELLED instance (409)

Follow the pattern established in src/design/api-03-instance-management.md. Do not write implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Role-based visibility strategy for GET /tasks is specified
Error codes for all failure modes are enumerated

result.summary: Designed API-04 task operation endpoints: GET /tasks (cursor-paginated, role-filtered), GET /tasks/:id, POST /tasks/:id/complete (with TASK_WORKER ownership check), POST /tasks/:id/assign, POST /tasks/:id/reassign. Design artifact at src/design/api-04-task-operations.md.
